---
name: Completed
description: "Post-skill wrap-up: ask if the user needs more help."
routing:
  engine_managed: true
---

:::ordered_block id=main
name: default_completed
steps:
  - id: ask_continue
    collect: wants_to_continue
    utterance: utter_ask_wants_to_continue
    description: >
      Does the user want to continue with another task? If they name a concrete
      task, set the collected memory entry to true and activate the appropriate skill — do
      not only re-ask this question.
    next:
      - if: "session.default_completed.wants_to_continue"
        then: more_help
      - else: csat_link
  - id: more_help
    instructions: >
      Ask what exactly the user needs help with.
      If the user replies with a specific task, activate the appropriate skill.
  - id: csat_link
    link: default_customer_satisfaction
:::
